panels.title: Functional Requirements
panels.body:
- 1:1 and Group real-time messaging
- Delivery status (sent/delivered/read)
- Presence (online/last seen)
- Media sharing (images/video/docs)
- End-to-end encryption (E2EE)

panels.title: Out-of-Scope
panels.body:
- Voice and video calling
- Status/Stories (simplified)
- Payment features
- Business API and marketplace
